attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Massachusetts corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($500K gross receipts); result.ma_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ma_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Massachusetts state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. MA requires addback of federal interest, IRC 199A deduction. MA allows deduction for dividends from 15%+ owned subsidiaries.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Massachusetts state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ma_state_additions = 0.0; if result.ma_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.ma_state_additions = result.ma_state_additions + result.ma_us_interest_income; endif set result.ma_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.ma_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.ma_state_subtractions = result.ma_state_subtractions + result.ma_municipal_interest; endif if result.ma_qualified_dividend_deduction != 0.0 then set result.ma_state_subtractions = result.ma_state_subtractions + result.ma_qualified_dividend_deduction; endif add (("Massachusetts additions: $" + string value of (result.ma_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.ma_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.ma_state_additions xdef { result.ma_state_additions result.ma_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.ma_state_additions xdef } {} result.ma_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.ma_state_subtractions xdef { result.ma_state_subtractions result.ma_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.ma_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.ma_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse { result.ma_state_subtractions result.ma_qualified_dividend_deduction f+ cvd /result.ma_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.ma_qualified_dividend_deduction 0.0 f== not ifelse "Massachusetts additions: $" result.ma_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.ma_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Massachusetts corporate income tax. Applies Massachusetts flat rate (8.0%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ma_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Massachusetts corporate tax (flat rate 8.0%); Apply Massachusetts 8.0% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ma_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.ma_apportioned_income + result.ma_state_additions - result.ma_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.ma_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.ma_taxable_income * result.ma_corp_tax_rate - result.ma_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.ma_refund_or_owed = result.ma_estimated_payments - result.ma_tax_liability; add "Massachusetts taxable income: $" + string value of (result.ma_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Massachusetts tax liability (8.0%): $" + string value of (result.ma_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.ma_apportioned_income result.ma_state_additions f+ result.ma_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ma_taxable_income xdef result.ma_taxable_income result.ma_corp_tax_rate fmul result.ma_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ma_tax_liability xdef result.ma_estimated_payments result.ma_tax_liability f- cvd /result.ma_refund_or_owed xdef "Massachusetts taxable income: $" result.ma_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Massachusetts tax liability (8.0%): $" result.ma_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
